display_information.name: Uprali
display_information.description: Build or buy, decided with proof.
display_information.long_description: Ask /uprali a build or buy question. Uprali works out the 3-year cost of each side, shows where every number came from and who owns it, flags the numbers only a person can give, and records the decision's fingerprint on NEAR testnet so anyone can check it later. It runs on private AI (NEAR AI Cloud) when configured.

slash_commands.description: Build or buy? Get a costed decision with sources
slash_commands.usage_hint: Should we build our own CRM or keep paying $720 a year for HubSpot?
